description: Turn the work a service business does into three fixed-price packages (smallest, middle, largest). Takes the cost base (fixed costs, owner pay, staff, delivery capacity) and the deliverables the business offers, each marked core (every client needs it), common (most clients want it) or premium (some clients want it), with its typical effort and direct cost. Returns each tier with what it includes and leaves out, its cost, break-even price, target price, a recommended price rounded up to a clean number, margin and profit per sale, how far the work can overrun before the margin hits zero, and a capacity check: hours needed, break-even clients a month, and the month profit after owner pay. All results are deterministic arithmetic with the method explained. Adjustments to what was built are treated as included, so effort carries a variance buffer.

delivery_hours_per_month.description: Hours the whole team can put into client work in a month, not counting sales and admin. Used to measure capacity and cost, never shown to clients.

monthly_fixed_costs.description: Overhead every month regardless of work: rent, software, insurance, vehicles, accounting.

monthly_owner_pay.description: What the owner needs to take home each month. It is treated as a cost, so profit is what is left after the owner is paid.

monthly_staff_cost.description: Salaried team cost per month, including payroll taxes. Default 0.

planned_utilization_pct.description: Share of delivery hours expected to be filled in a normal month. Default 80.

variable_cost_per_hour.description: Cost that rises with each delivery hour, such as subcontractor or crew wages. Default 0.

clients_per_month.description: Clients expected per month. When given, the capacity check shows hours needed and the month profit.

direct_cost.description: Cost paid out for this deliverable: materials, licenses, printing, subcontracted parts. Default 0.

effort_hours.description: Typical delivery effort for this deliverable, used for cost and capacity only.

level.description: core: every client needs it (in all three tiers). common: most clients want it (middle and largest tiers). premium: some clients want it (largest tier only).

name.description: A deliverable, for example "Logo suite in three formats" or "Site visit and measurements".

mix_pct.description: Expected share of clients choosing each tier, smallest first, adding to 100. Default 30, 50, 20.

offer_name.description: What the packages sell, for example "Brand identity" or "Bathroom remodel design".

outcome_value.description: What the result is worth to a typical client, for a value check on each price.

target_margin_pct.description: Profit as a share of price, after owner pay and every cost. Default 30.

tier_names.description: Names for the three tiers, smallest first. Default Essential, Standard, Complete.

variance_buffer_pct.description: Extra effort added to each tier because a fixed price absorbs jobs that run long. Default 15.

name: build_packages
title: Build three fixed packages
